title: Steve Jobs on Virtual Reality (D3, 2005)
summary: A one-minute clip of Steve Jobs at the D3 conference in 2005 discussing virtual reality. He compares VR headsets to headphones for video, an analogy later applied to Apple's Vision Pro.
why: HN commenters cite it in Vision Pro and AR threads as Jobs's concise take that a headset is like headphones for video.

quote.text: I think of the AVP like Steve Jobs once described: headphones for video
